hero.title: Twelve quiet rooms above the Pell valley
hero.text: A stone house of twelve bedrooms, a dining room that cooks from its own garden, and a fire lit from October.
hero.text2: On Ottery Rise, at the top of Pellbrook.

figures.l: the year the house took its first guests

statement.title: a house to arrive at slowly
statement.text: We keep the house the way it was built to be kept: thick walls, deep windows, and nobody in a hurry. Breakfast is served until eleven.

steps.title: Rooms for every kind of stay
steps.text: Garden rooms on the ground floor, valley rooms above, and two suites under the roof.

items.title: The garden rooms
items.text: French windows onto the lawn and a step down to the orchard.

items.title: The valley rooms
items.text: Deep sills, a writing desk and the whole valley in the window.

items.title: The roof suites
items.text: Beams overhead, a bath under the skylight and a sitting room of their own.

items.title: The snug rooms
items.text: Small, warm and kind to the budget, at the back of the house.
